comparisons.rule: Evaluate alpha 0.50 first. Alpha 0.25 may carry the gate only if alpha 0.50 fails. No other alpha may carry G1.

metric_parameters.ptsm_definition: mean max(p_old - p_new, 0) across eligible frames in the causal post-transition window
metric_parameters.miss_definition: no argmax prediction of the new label before the earlier of the next ground-truth transition and the 16-frame horizon

aggregation.global_ece: reconstructed from sampled per-video fixed-bin counts, correct sums, and confidence sums
aggregation.mean_tfi: macro mean over sampled video clusters
aggregation.mean_predicted_switches: macro mean over sampled video clusters
aggregation.mean_transition_delay: micro mean over transition events in sampled video clusters
aggregation.ptsm: micro mean over eligible post-transition frames in sampled video clusters
aggregation.missed_transition_rate: micro mean over transition events in sampled video clusters

gate_logic.global_ece: upper endpoint of CI for smoothed-minus-raw is below 0
gate_logic.ptsm: lower endpoint of CI for smoothed-minus-raw is above 0
gate_logic.accuracy: lower endpoint of CI for smoothed-minus-raw is at least -0.002
gate_logic.responsiveness: lower endpoint for delay or missed-transition-rate difference is above 0
gate_logic.overall: all four conditions pass for alpha 0.50, or for alpha 0.25 only after alpha 0.50 fails

anti_leakage_rules: predictions at frame t may use frames no later than t
pilot point estimates are not treated as confidence intervals
alpha, horizon, ECE bins, seed, resampling unit, and noninferiority margin are frozen before the confirmatory run
no post-result alpha search is permitted
